name: Hurricane Michael, Oct 2018
description: US Hurricane wind footprint for Hurricane Michael, October 11-12 2018. It made landfall near Mexico Beach, Florida as a Category 4 hurricane before weakening to a tropical storm.

vulnerability.source: Emanuel (2011) wind damage function, from the Oasis VulnerabilityLibrary
vulnerability.description: One function for every building: damage ratio = v³ / (1 + v³), where v = (V − 25.7) / (74.7 − 25.7) and V is the peak gust from ARA's wind footprint. Building type and occupancy are not used. Emanuel, K. (2011), Global warming effects on U.S. hurricane damage, Weather, Climate, and Society 3, 261–268.
